title: Vegetable consumption in metro cities
body: A Food Department officer keeps a worksheet in the range A1:E37. Each row records one Day (Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday), one City (four metro cities), one Vegetable (carrot, onion or potato), the Actual consumption in metric tons and the Surplus, worked out as actual consumption minus the quota fixed by the department. The list is long, and the officer finds it hard to compare figures by reading row after row. She selects A1:E37, clicks PivotTable on the Insert tab and places the report on the same worksheet. The PivotTable Field List now shows the field names Day, City, Vegetable, Actual and Surplus, which she can drag into the areas Report Filter, Column Labels, Row Labels and Values.
